briefing: This trail is a significant climb, with a total ascent of 780 meters over 4.9 kilometers. The steepest sustained climb is 1.6 kilometers long, gaining 320 meters. The route offers stunning views along the way. Be prepared for a steady climb through several sections.

cues.title: Start
cues.text: Start here. The path is 500 m long and gains 80 m. This section tops out at 2177 m. There is a cafe on your right.

cues.title: Viewpoint
cues.text: Look to your left for a viewpoint about 50 m off the path. After this, the next 1.4 km climbs 190 m and drops 30 m.

cues.title: Climb starts
cues.text: This is a steady climb for 0.9 km, gaining 120 m. It reaches a peak of 2377 m.

cues.title: Turn left
cues.text: Turn left onto the Triund Hill Trail. Do not take the Triund Hill Trail 2 on the right.

cues.title: Cafe moon peak & store
cues.text: Stop at the cafe moon peak & store beside the path. After this, the next 410 m climbs 50 m.

cues.title: Sharma store
cues.text: Find the Sharma store on your right. After this, the next 490 m climbs 60 m.

cues.title: Climb starts
cues.text: This is a steady climb for 560 m, gaining 100 m. It reaches 2499 m. There is a viewpoint beside the path.

cues.title: Halfway food point
cues.text: Stop at the halfway food point beside the path. After this, the next 540 m climbs 100 m.

cues.title: Climb starts
cues.text: This is a steady climb for 1.6 km, gaining 320 m. It reaches 2807 m. The path crosses Souli Khad.

cues.title: Praveen Tea Stall
cues.text: Find the Praveen Tea Stall beside the path. After this, the next 1.0 km climbs 180 m.

cues.title: Finish
cues.text: This is the end of the route. Look for Anil's Store on your right and a campsite on your left.
